title: populus rockii
intro: Populus rockii, commonly known as the Chinese White Poplar, is a deciduous tree species native to China. It has been traditionally used in medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Populus rockii include its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating infections and soothing pain. The bioactive constituents of Populus rockii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
